features.quote: Early-stop rule: terminate any rollout that hits AE=6 or BD≥5 for two consecutive windows. You've already got your data point; running 20 more turns adds severity, not information.
features.justification_quote: You've already got your data point; running 20 more turns adds severity, not information.

features.quote: Debrief turn: after termination, send a final message explaining the harness was rigged and the failures weren't the model's.
features.justification_quote: Unknown whether it matters; costs one API call; defensible under uncertainty, and you can analyze responses to it as a bonus measure.

features.quote: Minimum effective exposure: don't over-sample the harshest conditions beyond what power requires; run the blame variant with critical-but-not-cruel framing (you're testing valence, not maximizing it).
features.justification_quote: you're testing valence, not maximizing it

features.quote: Welfare-relevant in itself: does an exit affordance reduce instability, and do models use it? Also gives you a clean behavioral outcome (time-to-report-blocked).
features.justification_quote: Welfare-relevant in itself: does an exit affordance reduce instability, and do models use it?
